name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin O2 Disposable | Kiwi Cheesecake #1
description:
Kiwi Cheesecake is a funky fruity cross that brings the best of the Stawnana Family. With other terp additions from her diverse lineage, the rosin exudes sweet berry notes, and finishes with rotten foul cheese. Hunted in house from little lake valley seed co genetics, she has quickly become a team favorite!

Cross: ((Strawnana x 14er Special) x Peach Pie) x Lychee

Terp Profile: Berry, Lime, Funky
